name: Sonar wavelet CFG
plain: Performs CFG in the wavelet domain, so low and high bands get their own scales through a rule list. The low band and detail bands can use different blend modes.
math:
C,U=DWT(c),DWT(u), each optionally scaled by rule. D=C−U band by band, then scaled.
R=blend(U,D,yl_factor=difference_blend_strength(pcts)), then final scale. x̂=iDWT(R).
label: from code
